# License Model

## Purpose
The License Model manages software licensing, including products, features, and license requests.

## Key Entities
- **LicensingProduct**: A software product that can be licensed.
- **LicensingFeature**: A specific feature within a product.
- **LicenseRequest**: A request for a license for specific features/products.
- **LicensingEntity**: An entity (e.g., User or Organization) that holds a license.

## Class Diagram
```mermaid
classDiagram
    Baseclass <|-- LicensingProduct
    Baseclass <|-- LicensingFeature
    Baseclass <|-- LicenseRequest
    Baseclass <|-- LicensingEntity

    LicensingProduct "1" *-- "many" LicensingFeature
    LicenseRequest "many" -- "1" LicensingProduct
    LicenseRequest "many" -- "1" LicensingEntity
    
    LicenseRequest <|-- LicenseRequestToProduct
    LicenseRequest <|-- LicenseRequestToFeature
    LicenseRequest <|-- LicenseRequestToEntity

    class LicensingProduct {
        +String name
        +String productKey
    }
    class LicensingFeature {
        +String name
        +String featureKey
    }
    class LicenseRequest {
        +OffsetDateTime requestDate
        +OffsetDateTime expirationDate
    }
```
